decisions.reason: The web tool for weir dimensioning costs little to maintain and supports the core weir and flood-control business, and with the new weir products D and F it becomes more valuable as a lead generator, so the option stays open.

Product A was withdrawn, so the fouling detection system is now the firm's remaining option in this field; its prospects are still uncertain but it fits the energy recovery direction, so keeping it at low cost is justified for another year.
The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the established hydraulic steelwork offer and was launched only in 2024, so there is too little evidence to abandon it and keeping it costs little.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic heading toward digital networking and energy efficiency of water facilities, and its value is still unresolved, so it is worth keeping as a growth option.
The overflow flap gate line has its own website page and several models, which signals a firm commitment close to the core business, so dropping it after one year would be premature.
